sap.app.title: Overflow Toolbar - Different Controls
sap.app.description: An OverflowToolbar hosting a wide variety of control types (Label, Button, ToggleButton, CheckBox, SegmentedButton, ComboBox, DatePicker, Breadcrumbs, MenuButton, Input, SearchField, TimePicker, DateTimePicker, Select, OverflowToolbarButton, GenericTag) to demonstrate how each behaves when the toolbar overflows. A Slider dynamically resizes the toolbar.
